provenance.sequence_source: CloDF13 origin; bases X04466 284-913 (CloDF13 complete sequence, Nijkamp et al. 1986), reverse complement. Re-delimited (2026-11) from a 739 bp record (X04466 190-928, 1 mismatch): the old part also carried 15 bp upstream of the RNA II -35 (X04466 914-928, identical to pBR322 3123-3137) and the 94 bp past the RNA-to-DNA transition (X04466 190-283).

functional_claims.label: Spans CloDF13 X04466 284-913 (minus strand): from the RNA II promoter -35, annotated in the CloDF13 deposit at complement(908..913), to the RNA-to-DNA transition. The origin sequence is conserved with ColE1 (Stuitje et al. 1980) and X04466 marks the origin at 282 (= pBR322 2532, one of the three ColE1 start nucleotides); the part ends at the ColE1 part's end by alignment (X04466 284 = pBR322 2534).

source.quote: The sequence at the origin of replication is conserved. There are large differences in the nucleotide sequence downstream the replication origin
